---
title: "Data Science & Software Engineering"
listing:
  contents: projects.yml
  type: grid
  categories: true
  sort: "order desc"
  fields: [image, title, description, categories, feature, featured]
  grid-columns: 2
  image-height: "280px"
---

This my collection of curated content on **data science** and **software engineering**.

Select a category on the side to filter projects, or click a card to view the deployed application or notebook.

```{=html}
<script>
(function () {
  function applyFeatured() {
    // Accept either `feature` or `featured` in projects.yml.
    document
      .querySelectorAll('#listing-listing .quarto-grid-item')
      .forEach(function (gridItem) {
        var flag = gridItem.querySelector(
          '.card-other-values .feature, .card-other-values .featured'
        );
        var isFeatured =
          !!flag && (flag.textContent || '').trim().toLowerCase() === 'true';
        var colWrapper = gridItem.closest('[class*="g-col"]');
        gridItem.classList.toggle('card-featured', isFeatured);
        if (colWrapper) colWrapper.classList.toggle('g-col-featured', isFeatured);
      });
  }

  function slugify(text) {
    return (text || '')
      .trim()
      .toLowerCase()
      .replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '-')
      .replace(/^-+|-+$/g, '');
  }

  function colorCategories() {
    // Card tags
    document
      .querySelectorAll('#listing-listing .listing-category')
      .forEach(function (el) {
        var slug = slugify(el.textContent);
        if (slug) el.classList.add('cat-colored', 'cat-' + slug);
      });

    // Sidebar category list (skip "All", which has an empty data-category)
    document
      .querySelectorAll('.quarto-listing-category .category')
      .forEach(function (el) {
        if (!el.getAttribute('data-category')) return;
        // Use only the leading text node so the "(count)" span is excluded.
        var name = el.firstChild ? el.firstChild.textContent : el.textContent;
        var slug = slugify(name);
        if (slug) el.classList.add('cat-colored', 'cat-' + slug);
      });
  }

  function apply() {
    applyFeatured();
    colorCategories();
  }

  function init() {
    apply();
    var listEl = document.querySelector('#listing-listing .list');
    if (listEl) {
      // List.js reorders/refilters nodes; re-apply so classes survive.
      new MutationObserver(apply).observe(listEl, { childList: true });
    }
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
